name: multilingual-llava-bench
description: A multilingual, multimodal evaluation suite derived from LLaVA-style benchmarks that measures model performance on image+text tasks across multiple languages. It tests abilities such as visual question answering, image captioning, and multimodal reasoning in non-English languages. The benchmark helps assess robustness of multimodal models to linguistic variation and cross-lingual generalization.
reputation: A small community-maintained Hugging Face benchmark used for multilingual multimodal research but not widely adopted as a standard suite.
